abstract: Recent BAO, CMB, and Type Ia supernova constraints on the dark-energy equation of state show a tension with the cosmological-constant model at the heart of $Λ$CDM, partly driven by low-redshift supernova measurements. We present the LEMAITRE project, a new measurement of the dark energy equation of state, based on a distinct SN~Ia dataset (2800 from ZTF, 170 from SNLS and 300 from HSC), a dedicated calibration program, and a new, independent analysis pipeline.
